name: the-orange
provenance: Chosen by Nathan, 2026-08-30, as the founding scene of the repertory: 'a goblin and a drow in a room and the drow is trying to convince the goblin to give him a particularly ripe orange.' Expected DECLARED for several campaigns; its beats are the arc's task list.

scenes.title: A drow wants a ripe orange that a goblin has
scenes.declared: Beats beyond the first need capabilities no campaign has built yet. The Chattel (merged 2026-08-30) put carried things on the wire, so the snapshot DOES now carry an inventory channel -- but only for the possessed body: `/self/carrying` is a list of {entity, noun}, while a `social[]` entry is still exactly {entity, label, grievance, hostile}. Beat 2 therefore asks for the co-located half of what The Chattel shipped for self. Beyond it, no verb in the in-character list addresses another creature: ask asks the body you wear how IT feels, write speaks a line of Common into your OWN margin, and the operator instruments provoke and soothe carry no utterance. Delete this declaration the moment the scene passes -- STALE-DECL will insist.

beats.description: two creatures share a room, and the possessing will can tell
one of them carries a thing that can change hands, and the possessing will can see it
